title: Track the boundary term when extending across a half-line
obstacle: A half-line derivative is incorrectly identified with a full-line derivative.
procedure: State the zero-extension distribution identity including the boundary Dirac term.
Prove the actual trace or show the zero-trace condition that removes the term.
Only then transport the ODE/Fourier identity and select a representative.
verification: Check boundary coefficient, Fourier convention and the justified trace.
positive_example: The zero-trace BO free representative is connected to its distributional equation.
negative_example: An arbitrary nonzero trace cannot be dropped by a zero-extension notation change.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.

    (E4 : ChenE4OperatorCore u0 hu0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ell eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)

    let f := chenFreeResolventVector E4 t (ell / Real.sqrt t) eps heps

          freeBoundaryValue t ell eps (P.representative Q) /
            (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (t : ℂ)))) := by
